name: Kawamuki Shinsatsushitsu: Boku wa Seishoku Marmot
original_name: 皮むき診察室 僕は生殖モルモット
source:
The story of an innocent boy used as a medical guinea pig by a sexy doctor!

While trying to understand the workings of the body, the sexy doctor toys with the body of her boy victim...
